fit_reason: Whole boat (2018 Cobalt R5 Surf) listed by a private seller; boat is detailable even though trailer is not included.
findings: Navy hull sides look glossy with clean reflections on both port and starboard sides
White vinyl seating in the cockpit and rear bench looks clean with no visible staining
Sea grass flooring and swim platform mat appear clean
Light grime and dark residue around the outdrive and lower transom area under the swim platform
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Cobalt R5 Surf and it already looks sharp, especially the navy hull and the white seating. If you want it fully buyer-ready, we do a pre-sale wash and wax and can clean up the lower transom and drive area, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
